_note: jjiroo-tancheon-duck-chase-001 storyboard-first cut plan. Provisional pet identity is locked in storyboard/style-lock.md and must remain stable across all cuts.

episode.basis: raw episode narrative -> provisional style lock -> storyboard cuts -> keyframes -> sequential video

cuts.beat: Sunny Tancheon walk establishes mother, Jjiroo, and Jjonga moving lightly along the riverside path.
cuts.cameraConcept: Vertical medium-wide establishing shot with the river and dirt path both clearly visible.
cuts.motionPotential: Light walking loop, leash sway, breeze in grass, easy opening pan.

cuts.beat: The dogs enjoy the walk by sniffing the ground and greeting the environment before the incident begins.
cuts.cameraConcept: Lower angle slice-of-life shot focused on dog behavior with the mother partly framed above.
cuts.motionPotential: Sniffing noses, tail flicks, tiny weight shifts, passing path energy.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo suddenly spots a group of ducks resting near the riverbank and locks onto them.
cuts.cameraConcept: Reaction shot that keeps Jjiroo foregrounded while ducks are readable in the distance.
cuts.motionPotential: Ear perk, eye snap, subtle push-in toward ducks.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo crouches and stalks forward with intense focus while the harness strains and the ducks remain unaware for a beat.
cuts.cameraConcept: Tension-building side profile with low stalking posture and riverbank geography still legible.
cuts.motionPotential: Cautious paw steps, body compression, leash tension, held suspense.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo snaps free and rockets toward the ducks as they burst up and flee into the river.
cuts.cameraConcept: Dynamic diagonal chase composition with ducks breaking toward water and mother lagging behind.
cuts.motionPotential: Sprint smear, duck flutter, speed lines implied by composition, strong directional flow.

cuts.beat: Without hesitation, Jjiroo dives into the river after the ducks while Jjonga stays back on shore.
cuts.cameraConcept: Impact shot at the water entry point, framed to show the exact bank Jjiroo launched from.
cuts.motionPotential: Splash burst, airborne-to-water transition, startled reaction from shore.

cuts.beat: The mother jumps into the river to chase Jjiroo, who is already confidently swimming ahead.
cuts.cameraConcept: Layered depth shot with soaked mother behind, Jjiroo midstream, ducks farther ahead.
cuts.emotion: Alarmed rescue energy with comic mismatch.
cuts.motionPotential: Water churn, arm reach, strong forward swim lines, widening distance gag.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo powers through the current and the mother struggles to keep up, proving how fast he is in water.
cuts.cameraConcept: Longer vertical action frame emphasizing the river lane and the distance between mother and dog.
cuts.emotion: Escalation with a hint of absurdity.
cuts.motionPotential: Upstream swim rhythm, ripples, strained pursuit, ducks escaping out of reach.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo gives up on the ducks, turns back, and climbs out of the river on his own at the readable bank exit.
cuts.cameraConcept: Recovery shot focused on the same shoreline geography so the self-rescue reads clearly.
cuts.motionPotential: Wet dog climb, water shake setup, mother still in water behind.

cuts.beat: Final payoff: Jjiroo stands safely on the bank, dripping but calm, and looks back at the soaked mother with a puzzled 'why are you in there' expression.
cuts.cameraConcept: Comedy reaction frame with Jjiroo foreground on dry land and the mother stranded in water behind him.
cuts.motionPotential: Tiny hold, blink, subtle head tilt, lingering reaction beat for the punchline.
